core.name: One-command setup
core.description: Docker, SSL, DB, assets — running in minutes
core.details: `bash bin/setup-env` spins up Docker containers (MySQL, Redis, Mailpit), generates self-signed SSL certificates, installs PHP and Node dependencies, runs migrations, and builds frontend assets. No local PHP or MySQL required.

core.name: Hot reload (HMR)
core.description: Instant browser updates with no page refresh
core.details: Vite's Hot Module Replacement updates only the changed module in the browser instantly, without a full page reload. Your Vue component state is preserved across edits.

core.name: Type-safe routes
core.description: Ziggy generates TypeScript helpers from Laravel routes
core.details: Ziggy exports all named Laravel routes to the frontend as a typed object. You get autocompletion and compile-time errors when calling `route('user.profile', { id })` instead of building URLs by hand.

core.name: SSR opt-in
core.details: Add `->withSSR()` to any `Inertia::render()` call to server-render that page. The SSR server starts automatically with `composer dev`. Use it for public SEO pages; authenticated pages skip it by default.

core.name: Filament admin
core.description: Full admin panel included out of the box
core.details: Filament 5 is pre-configured with a custom theme and dark mode. Modules like Billing, Roadmap, and Announcements register their own Filament resources automatically — no manual setup needed.

core.name: Dark / light mode
core.details: A CSS variable-based theme system lets users toggle between dark and light mode. The preference is persisted in localStorage and respected on every page load, including SSR.

core.name: shadcn-vue UI
core.details: A curated set of accessible components (Button, Dialog, Dropdown, Table, and more) from shadcn-vue, pre-integrated with Tailwind CSS 4. Components are copied into your codebase — you own and modify them freely.

core.name: PHPStan level 5
core.details: Static analysis runs on every commit via a pre-commit hook and in CI. Level 5 catches undefined variables, wrong argument types, and unreachable code without requiring full type annotations across the codebase.

core.name: Playwright E2E
core.details: End-to-end tests run against a real browser with a seeded test database. Module tests are co-located in `modules/*/tests/e2e/`. A custom `SaucebasePage` helper provides common actions like login and navigation.

core.name: Commitlint
core.details: Conventional commit format (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, etc.) is enforced by a commit-msg hook. This feeds into automated changelog generation and keeps `git log` readable across the team.

modules.title: Auth
modules.description: Complete authentication system with login, registration, magic link (passwordless), password reset, email verification, and OAuth integration (Google, GitHub).

features.name: Login & Register
features.description: Login, registration, and password reset flows
features.details: Full login, registration, and password reset flows with pre-built Vue pages, form validation, rate limiting, and redirect handling after authentication.

features.name: Email Verification
features.details: Users receive a verification email after registration. Protected routes can require a verified email via the `verified` middleware. A resend flow is included.

features.name: Social Login
features.details: Users can sign in with Google or GitHub. New accounts are created automatically, and existing accounts are linked by email.

features.name: Impersonation
features.description: Log in as any user from the admin panel
features.details: Admins can impersonate any user directly from the Filament admin panel. A banner shows when impersonation is active, and you can switch back to your account at any time.

features.name: Magic Link
features.details: Users enter their email and receive a signed, time-limited login link. No password required. Powered by a signed URL with a 15-minute expiry and single-use enforcement.

modules.title: Settings
modules.description: Account settings pages for managing profile info, avatar, password, and connected social accounts.

features.name: Profile Info
features.details: Users can update their display name and email address from their account settings page.

features.name: Avatar Upload
features.details: Users can upload a custom profile photo. If no photo is set, the avatar falls back to the one from their connected social account, then to a default image.

features.name: Password Change
features.details: Users can update their password after confirming their current one. An email notification is sent when the password is changed.

features.name: Connected Accounts
features.details: Users can see which social providers (Google, GitHub) are connected to their account and disconnect them when needed.

modules.title: Billing
modules.description: Subscription management and payment processing via Stripe with checkout sessions, billing portal, invoices, and webhook processing.

features.name: Checkout
features.details: A hosted checkout collects customer details and redirects to a payment page. Supports one-time payments and recurring subscriptions.

features.name: Subscriptions
features.details: Create, cancel, and resume subscriptions. Status changes are kept in sync automatically via webhooks — no manual polling needed.

features.name: Billing Portal
features.description: Let users manage their own billing
features.details: Users are redirected to a hosted billing portal where they can update payment methods, download invoices, and cancel or modify their subscription.

features.name: Webhooks
features.details: Payment events are verified and processed reliably. Duplicate events are safely ignored, and failed payments update subscription status automatically.

modules.title: Roadmap
modules.description: Public roadmap with feature requests, voting, moderation, six statuses, and a Filament admin panel.

features.name: Feature Requests
features.details: Users submit ideas and bug reports on a public roadmap. Posts include a title, description, and category. Admins can edit or remove any post from the Filament panel.

features.name: Voting
features.details: Authenticated users can upvote or downvote ideas. Vote counts are displayed publicly and used to rank items on the board.

features.name: Sorting
features.description: Sort by votes, newest, or oldest
features.details: Users can sort the roadmap by most voted, newest, or oldest. The default view shows the most popular ideas first.

features.name: Admin Panel
features.details: Admins can review, approve, reject, and update the status of any roadmap item from the Filament admin panel.

modules.title: Announcements
modules.description: Site-wide announcement banners with scheduling, audience targeting, and cookie-based dismissal — managed from the Filament admin panel.

features.name: Banner
features.description: Fixed bar above the nav on every page
features.details: A fixed bar rendered above the navigation on every page. Built with an Inertia shared prop so it works with SSR and client-side navigation without additional requests.

features.name: Scheduling
features.description: Set start and end times for banners
features.details: Set a `starts_at` and `ends_at` timestamp on any announcement. Visibility is evaluated on every request — no cron job or queue worker needed.

features.name: Audience Targeting
features.description: Show on public, authenticated pages, or both
features.details: Control whether the banner appears on public (unauthenticated) pages, authenticated pages, or both. Configured independently per announcement.

features.name: Dismissal
features.details: A ✕ button lets users permanently dismiss a banner. The dismissed state is stored in a cookie (1-year expiry) with no database writes. A new announcement with a different ID will reappear regardless.

features.name: Admin Panel
features.details: Create, edit, and delete announcements in Filament. The rich text editor supports bold, italic, underline, links, and lists for formatting banner content.

modules.title: Themes
modules.description: Visual theme editor for designing your app's colors, fonts, radius, and shadows. Pick a built-in theme or build your own, then bake it into CSS — no runtime overhead.

features.name: Built-in Themes
features.details: Curated built-in themes are included, each fully defining colors, fonts, radius, and shadows for both light and dark mode.

features.name: Visual Editor
features.description: Live color, font, radius, and shadow editing
features.details: A floating panel on every page lets you edit every visual token live. Changes preview instantly in both light and dark mode without a page reload.

features.name: Dark & Light Mode
features.description: Full dark/light support for every theme
features.details: Every theme defines separate color sets for light and dark mode. A per-field sync toggle lets you lock values to be identical across modes or edit them independently.

features.name: Baked CSS
features.description: Export your theme as static CSS
features.details: Once you're happy with a design, run one command to write the theme into a static CSS file. No database reads or runtime overhead — your styles ship as plain CSS.

modules.title: Blog
modules.description: Full-featured blog with posts, categories, tags, and a Filament admin panel for content management.

features.name: Posts
features.details: Create and publish blog posts with a rich text editor, slug, excerpt, cover image, and publish date. Supports draft and scheduled publishing.

features.name: Categories & Tags
features.description: Organize content with categories and tags
features.details: Organize posts into hierarchical categories and tag them for filtering. Category and tag archive pages are automatically generated with pagination.

features.name: Admin Panel
features.description: Filament admin panel for content management
features.details: Manage all blog content from Filament with draft/published status, scheduled publishing, and bulk actions for efficient content management.

features.name: SEO Optimized
features.description: Meta tags, Open Graph, and structured data for every post
features.details: Each post gets its own meta title, description, Open Graph image, and JSON-LD structured data for rich search results and social sharing previews.

modules.title: Webhooks
modules.description: Send reliable HTTP callbacks to external services when events occur in your app, with delivery logs and retry handling.

features.name: Event Triggers
features.description: Fire webhooks on any app event
features.details: Register listeners for any application event and automatically dispatch an HTTP POST to configured endpoints. Supports custom payloads and per-event endpoint routing.

features.name: Delivery Logs
features.details: Every delivery attempt is logged with the request body, response status, and latency. Browse the full history from the admin panel to diagnose issues.

features.name: Retry Handling
features.details: Failed deliveries are retried automatically with exponential backoff. You can also trigger a manual retry from the delivery log for any failed attempt.

features.name: Failure Alerts
features.description: Get notified when deliveries fail repeatedly
features.details: After a configurable number of consecutive failures, an alert is sent to the team. Endpoints can be temporarily disabled to prevent noise during known outages.

modules.title: Integrations
modules.description: Connect your app with third-party services like Slack, Zapier, and more through a unified integration layer.

features.name: Slack
features.details: Post messages to any Slack channel when events occur in your app. Supports custom message formatting, channel routing per event type, and OAuth app installation.

features.name: Zapier
features.description: Trigger Zapier workflows from your app
features.details: Connect to thousands of apps via Zapier triggers. Any event in your app can kick off a Zapier workflow without custom code.

features.name: Custom Connections
features.details: A driver-based integration layer lets you implement custom adapters for any third-party service. Register them alongside the built-in drivers with no framework changes.

features.name: Unified Layer
features.details: All integrations share a common interface for connecting, sending events, and handling credentials. Switching or adding providers requires no changes to your event code.

modules.title: Notifications
modules.description: In-app and email notifications with templates, user preferences, and delivery tracking for every channel.

features.name: In-App
features.details: Notifications appear in a dropdown bell menu and are marked read on open. Unread count is updated in real time via broadcasting without a full page reload.

features.name: Email
features.details: Each notification type has a corresponding email template. Emails are queued and sent via Laravel's mail system — swap the driver (SMTP, Mailgun, SES) in the config.

features.name: Templates
features.details: In-app and email notification content is defined in template classes. Subject, body, and action URL are customizable per notification type without touching core code.

features.name: Preferences
features.details: Users control which notifications they receive and on which channels from a preferences page. Preferences are evaluated before dispatch — muted channels are skipped entirely.

modules.title: Analytics
modules.description: Track pageviews, custom events, and user behavior with a privacy-friendly built-in dashboard — no third-party scripts.

features.name: Pageviews
features.details: Every page navigation is tracked automatically via an Inertia event listener. No script tags or manual calls needed — views are recorded server-side with referrer and path.

features.name: Custom Events
features.details: Fire custom events from anywhere in the frontend with a single helper call. Events are batched and sent to a lightweight endpoint that writes them to the analytics store.

features.name: Dashboard
features.details: A Filament dashboard page visualises pageviews, unique visitors, top pages, and custom event counts over configurable date ranges. No third-party service required.

features.name: Privacy First
features.details: All data is stored in your own database. No cookies are set, no external scripts are loaded, and no personal data leaves your server — fully GDPR-compliant by default.
